raw_snippet: ChatGPT users in the United States can buy from Etsy merchants (and, soon, from Shopify merchants) in the chat using checkout powered by Stripe.
value_text: OpenAI and Stripe let ChatGPT users buy from Etsy merchants in the chat, on an open protocol (Sep 2025)
note: Stripe, 29 Sep 2025: a marketplace opened to an outside AI agent through the Agentic Commerce Protocol, an open standard Stripe and OpenAI released the same day.

raw_snippet: Walmart said Tuesday that it has reached a deal with OpenAI to allow shoppers to buy items directly through ChatGPT.
value_text: Walmart announces a deal with OpenAI to let shoppers buy through ChatGPT (Oct 2025)
note: CNBC, 14 Oct 2025: a platform letting an outside AI agent sell its goods, on terms it set; counted as an opening (it was context until 22 Sep 2026).
